incidentTitle: Front End Critically Low on Memory
defaultHumanInterventionLoop: App Service (Web Apps)/DataRoleTeam Business Hours Only
incidentProcessingGuide: Create an EXECUTION_PLAN using the below guidelines
- Fetch the alerting discussion entry and extract the stamp name from it.
- Identify the KUSTO_CLUSTER from the discussion entries. There can be multiple clusters.
- Identify the stamp names STAMP_NAME that has been impacted. There can be multiple stamps impacted.
- Identify the InstanceName from the discussion entries. There can be multiple instances, one per row.
- If the result of the query does NOT include the STAMP_NAME and instance names from the discussion, consider it as transient
- If transient, tag the icm with tag Falcon-AgentMitigated
- Repeat running run_alert_kusto_query 10 times with a gap of 10 minutes or until InstanceNames from original discussion entries are not returned. In each iteration:
- Ensure that you've waited for 10 minutes after the last iteration.
- run_alert_kusto_query and check if it returns any rows.
- Post discussion Entry into ICM Incident with the following list details regarding the ALERT_SIGNAL: MONITORING_ITERATION, NUM_ROWS_RETURNED
- If InstanceNames > 0, increase MONITORING_ITERATION by 1 and add wait_timer for 10 minutes.
- If number of InstanceNames == 0, this confirms that the ALERT_SIGNAL has been cleared. Mitigate the Incident. Tag the icm with tag Falcon-AgentMitigated and EXIT THE LOOP.
